name: Packing List Builder
description: Creates categorized packing checklists with quantity columns and trip-type and weather conditionals. Gathers destination, trip duration, activities planned, weather forecast, and traveler preferences to produce a printable packing list organized by category with check-off boxes. Use when the user asks to create a packing list, figure out what to pack, prepare luggage for a trip, or organize travel gear by category. Do NOT use for trip itinerary building (use trip-itinerary-builder), travel budgets (use budget-travel-planner), or moving and relocation packing.
